{{Quote|That's Myahh, former first lieutenant of the Endar Rebirth, the first scout vessel sent here to evaluate the possibility of recolonization. Ship disappeared five years ago. Then three days ago, Myahh comes staggering out of one of the collapsed buildings outside the base. He lived out there, no weapons but what he made from salvage, holding his own against the rakghouls, all that time.|[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Bhoenn]]|<ref name="Operation Salvage" />}}
'''Myahh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. As first [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the ''[[Endar Rebirth]]'', Myahh was part of the ship's mission to investigate [[Destruction of Taris|devastated]] [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] as a potential site for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] planned [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]] in the aftermath of the [[Great Galactic War]]. At some point the ship was destroyed in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], and Myahh was among a small group of survivors to escape to the planet surface.<ref name="Operation Salvage" />

Myahh and the [[Republic soldier]]s lived in the [[Tularan Marsh|Tarisian wilderness]] for five [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before he came across a [[75th Legion forward camp|Republic encampment]] overseen by [[Bhoenn|Commander Bhoenn]]. With the aid of Republic agents, Myahh and the soldiers were rescued and promised Republic support for the rest of their lives.<ref name="Operation Salvage" />

==Personality and traits==
After five years of isolation in the [[Rakghoul]]-infested wilderness of Taris, Myahh had developed a jittery, alarmist personality. He was jumpy and terrified of many things, fearing attack even when none was forthcoming.<ref name="Operation Salvage" />

==Behind the scenes==
Myahh was first introduced as an NPC character in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. His role was in presenting the player character with the mission "Operation Salvage," in which the player must rescue the surviving members of the ''Endar Rebirth'' from the Tularan Marsh region on Taris.<ref name="Operation Salvage" />
